issues.quote: | CRM activity in, console replies out | clearing, one place to look | unknown [Q18] | integrations-backend owner |
issues.concern: Clearing reads only CRM activity, which is the sales record. My advisors and service BDC answer from the desk phone, Xtime/myKaarma texting or the DMS, and the proof a customer was handled is an appointment booked in the scheduler or an RO opened. With no scheduler/DMS activity read, every service item clears only by someone clicking 'Handled elsewhere'. On a busy drive nobody clicks, the queue fills with handled customers and the BDC stops trusting it.
